name: orbit-satellite-badge
title: Orbit Satellite Badge
description: A small circular notification satellite executing continuous Keplerian orbit around an icon container.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Keplerian Satellite Revolution: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
